_meta.what: Fruit Ninja 2P (real-time 1v1) — Firebase Realtime Database security rules fragment
_meta.how: MERGE these nodes into your existing rules in Firebase Console → Realtime Database → Rules. Do NOT replace existing rules (Ludo/wallet rules must stay).
_meta.guarantee: A player can ONLY write fnRooms/{roomId}/players/{ownUid}/* and fnPlayer/{ownUid}/* — i.e. a player can only update their OWN score. Timers and the result node are write-once (first write wins), so no client can extend the 2-minute match or overwrite a result.
notes: fnQueue/waiting: names/photos of queueing players are public to any signed-in user; entries contain no private data.
fnRooms room-root writes are only allowed for: (a) creating the room, (b) flipping status to 'finished' when a result exists, (c) deleting a finished room (cleanup).
fnQueue/waiting is indexed on ts for stale-entry scans.

$roomId..write: auth != null && (!data.exists() || data.child('uid').val() === auth.uid || newData.child(auth.uid).exists() || (!newData.exists() && data.child(auth.uid).exists()))

auth != null && ((!data.exists() && newData.child('status').val() == 'countdown') || (data.exists() && data.child('status').val() != 'finished' && newData.child('status').val() == 'finished') || (data.exists() && data.child('status').val() == 'finished'))
